files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: In riders.csv, write off negative balances: set credit_balance to 0 for every rider whose balance is below zero, and leave empty balances empty. `result` should be the total of credit_balance over all riders with a balance after this change, rounded to 2 decimals (a single number).
intended_computation: Read riders.csv; replace every negative credit_balance by 0 (empty balances stay empty); return the sum of the non-empty balances after the change, rounded to 2 decimals (one number).

acceptable_variants.notes: a numpy float is the same number
